intro.text: An ocean-covered planet with few land masses, forming a double planet with Komashi around a large red-orange sun.

description.text: Seen from Komashi, it shines as a pale blue daystar, the only light in the sky that could pierce the shroud.

Nagadan scientists studied it through telescopes and then with a hion-powered space bus that orbited it. They found that its Sho Del inhabitants live mostly on boats, with a few settlements on land, and picked up no radio signals.

items.text: A space bus from Komashi landed there, and its crew met the Sho Del for the first time.
